Name: Shiko - New Custom NPC
Author: moopdrea
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/ZnbN0j4J/sd.png[/img]﻿﻿﻿

Please report any bugs![/center][left]
[size=3]﻿[/size][size=2]There's a new face in town and her name is Shiko Takahashi. She's a retired model who has decided to move from Zuzu City to Pelican Town in hopes to experience a simpler kind of lifestyle. Shiko's a bit of a mystery, kind of a whirlwind and very unpredictable. She's currently crashing at Gus's saloon, but she hopes to have a home to call her own one day. She's marriageable with her own custom heart events and schedule!

Check out the wiki page made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/58336006]psychicberry [/url]﻿for more info regarding Shiko! [url=https://stardewvalley.fandom.com/wiki/Shiko]https://stardewvalley.fandom.com/wiki/Shiko

[/url][b]Update[/b]: Working on something ;) [img]https://i.postimg.cc/L4VSf0hT/transform.png[/img]﻿

[/size][size=2][b]Installation:
[/b][/size]- Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher
- Place in your "\Stardew Valley\Mods" folder

[b]Requires[/b]:
- [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿﻿
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿

[b]For Spouse Room[/b]:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1820]TMXLoader[/url]﻿ 
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url]﻿

[b]Known Bugs:[/b]
- Shows up at festivals, but disappears during the main events (For example, at the Flower dance you can ask her to dance, but once the dancing starts she disappears, so it looks like you're dancing on your own... kinda awkward. I have yet to figure out how to fix this;;)
- For saved games, she doesn't move until you at least talk to her, the next day her schedule seems to work just fine.
- If the wedding screen is black that's because your window isn't full-screened!

[b]Notes:
[/b]- Birthday: Winter 6
- Loves: Golden Pumpkin, Maki Roll, Pearl, Prismatic Shard, Red Plate, Ruby, Salad, Wine

[b]Uninstalling (putting it under a spoiler because of its length):[/b]
[spoiler]Uninstall:
1. Remove the mod from your mods folder
2. Locate your save file. To this by pressing the windows key+R, then paste %appdata% and then locate your "StardewValley" folder
If you're having trouble with this please check out: https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Saves#Find_your_save_files
3. Go to "saves" folder. In there should be folders with the name of your farmer followed by numbers. (i.e "Papaya_1234567")
4. We have two files in interest, but we will focus on the file that is the same name as the folder you just clicked into. You'll want to right click and click Edit with Notepad++ or just open it in Notepad (If you don't have Notepad++)
5. Before we get to editing, make sure you save a copy of your save somewhere safe!! This part is very crucial.
6. Inside, press CTRL+F to begin searching, and in the search field, enter "Shiko". This should bring up results.
7. Basically we want to remove all instances Shiko from your save file, one of the results should look like <NPC><name>Shiko</name>. Start from <NPC> and higlight all the way to </NPC>. It should look like this:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/hGwJsx7n/1.png[/img]﻿
8. Another result should look like <item><key><string>Shiko</string>. Highlight from <item> all the way to </item>. It should look like this:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/9fzRy101/2.png[/img]﻿
9. Finally (although I'm unsure if all save files have this? If you don't ignore this step.) Remove <string>Shiko_Introduction</string>.
10. Save and exit the file, next go to the 2nd file that says "SaveGameInfo". Make sure to save a copy of this file somewhere safe before you start editing!
11. The process is the same as the previous one. Press CTRL+F to begin searching, and in the search field, enter "Shiko".
12. Find <item><key><string>Shiko</string>. Highlight from <item> all the way to </item>. It should look like this:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/9fzRy101/2.png[/img]﻿
13. Same as the previous file, (although I'm unsure if all save files have this? If you don't ignore this step.) Remove <string>Shiko_Introduction</string>.
14. Save your file, now your save will be fixed and ready to play!

If you are married to Shiko, you'll need to follow this part in addition to the previous steps:
1. Remove <spouse>Shiko</spouse> from both files

Please PM me if you are having trouble
[/spoiler]
